one_liner: fully managed, multi‑cloud developer data platform for MongoDB
access_notes: Self-serve: create an Atlas org/project on the free tier and provision OAuth2 service accounts (and optionally programmatic API keys/Digest auth) directly in the UI; no review or partner onboarding required for standard use.
mcp_notes: Official MongoDB servers: Atlas Managed MCP Server (MongoDB-hosted) and the MongoDB MCP Server (self-hosted). See https://www.mongodb.com/products/updates/now-ga-mongodb-atlas-managed-mcp-server/ and https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mcp-server/overview/.

evidence.quote: The API accepts 2 different authentication methods: Digest auth (http); Service accounts (oauth2).
In the MongoDB Atlas Administration API documentation, click Download source… Right‑click the OpenAPI specification format you want to download and copy the link.
You can configure Atlas to send alert notifications to a webhook endpoint as HTTP POST requests for programmatic processing.
Free clusters are free forever and suitable for users learning MongoDB or developing small proof‑of‑concept applications.
MongoDB is now available as a native plugin… backed by the MongoDB Atlas Managed MCP Server, a MongoDB‑hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.
The Atlas Administration API doesn't provide access to the data stored in your clusters.
